title: Distilled Reinforcement Learning for LLM Post-training
abstract: arXiv:2607.17247v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) post-training is essential for improving reasoning, adaptation, and alignment. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, RL relies on coarse-grained outcome supervision, resulting in difficult credit assignment and limited capability to acquire new knowledge. OPD, meanwhile, unconditionally matches teacher logits through KL divergence, which creates a dilemma: similar teachers provide little new knowledge, while substantially different teachers often yield ineffective guidance, largely restricting OPD to within-family distillation. We propose Distilled Reinforcement Learning (Distilled RL), which integrates teacher supervision into the RL objective to provide fine-grained guidance, selectively transfer new knowledge and avoid unconditional imitation. translated_title: 面向大语言模型后训练的蒸馏强化学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）后训练对于提升推理能力、适应能力和对齐能力至关重要。现有方法主要遵循两种范式：强化学习（RL）和在线策略蒸馏（OPD）。然而，强化学习依赖于粗粒度的结果监督，导致信用分配困难且获取新知识的能力有限；而在线策略蒸馏则通过KL散度无条件地匹配教师模型的logits，这造成了一个两难困境：相似的教师模型几乎不提供新知识，而差异较大的教师模型往往产生无效的指导，这在很大程度上将在线策略蒸馏限制在同系列模型内部的蒸馏。我们提出蒸馏强化学习，该方法将教师监督融入强化学习目标中，以提供细粒度的指导、选择性地迁移新知识并避免无条件模仿。蒸馏强化学习包含三个组件：带剪裁的逆重要性采样……
tldr: 该论文提出蒸馏强化学习方法，将教师模型的细粒度监督融入强化学习目标中，实现选择性的知识迁移，同时克服了强化学习信用分配困难和在线策略蒸馏无条件模仿的双重局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Distilled Reinforcement Learning, which integrates fine-grained teacher supervision into the RL objective to enable selective knowledge transfer, overcoming both the coarse-grained credit assignment limitation of RL and the unconditional imitation dilemma of on-policy distillation.
